typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BUS_FILE_NAME as string (),
	BUS_PATH as string (),
	BUS_PATH_FINAL as string (),
	ORA_Password as string (),
	ORA_Server as string (),
	ORA_Username as string ()
}

source(output(
		In_data as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource split(substring(toString(In_data), toInteger(12), toInteger(4)) == 'SBSB', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Case1 sink(input(
		IN_DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		IN_DATA = In_data)) ~> OLEDBDestination
